title: Grand Unification v23
abstract: This is the complete substrate specification using native measurement units. We derive all physical reality from five axioms (D,S,L,N,ℚ) using only Lex-Glyph notation and VFR Logismos. This is the cleanest possible expression of reality. No approximations. No empirical constants. No free parameters. Pure geometry throughout.
